What\'s needed Everything is in Set up on the phone: Game files → Download from Blizzard, then install Reign of Chaos and The Frozen Throne with your CD keys (Blizzard\'s own installers, in the app). Or bring a Warcraft III 1.27 folder installed on a PC (Pick folder or Pick zip). These must be in it: From GOG: the offline installer of Warcraft: Orcs & Humans (on GOG\'s site, the game\'s offline backup game installers): setup_warcraft_….exe, and every setup_warcraft_…-1.bin (-2.bin…) file that came with it. Copy them to the phone\'s Downloads, then Game files → Pick GOG installer and pick them together (touch and hold the first, then tap the others). The app unpacks and converts it by itself (a few minutes). The installed folder from a PC (C:\\GOG Games\\…) or a zip of it works too. What the app takes from it: From GOG: the offline installer of Warcraft II: Battle.net Edition (on GOG\'s site, the game\'s offline backup game installers): setup_warcraft_ii_….exe, and every setup_warcraft_ii_…-1.bin (-2.bin…) file that came with it. Copy them to the phone\'s Downloads, then Game files → Pick GOG installer and pick them together (touch and hold the first, then tap the others). The app unpacks and converts it by itself (a few minutes). The installed folder from a PC (C:\\GOG Games\\…) or a zip of it works too. What the app takes from it: The game\'s data The DATA folder with DATA.WAR and the other .WAR files (maps, units, sounds, the cutscenes\' pictures). The game\'s data The four tomes in Support\\TOMES: maps, units, graphics. Sounds and speech Install.mpq, beside the game\'s program (about 490 MB). Converted for the phone The app does this itself once the files above are in, in a few minutes. Game files → Convert again redoes it. The game\'s program Warcraft III.exe, what starts the game. Reign of Chaos War3.mpq: the first game\'s units, maps, sound and campaign. The Frozen Throne War3x.mpq and War3xLocal.mpq: the expansion\'s data and its campaign. Patch 1.27 War3Patch.mpq. If it\'s missing, the PC install hasn\'t been patched: install the 1.27b patch on the PC first. Skirmish and custom maps (optional) The Maps folder: skirmish and custom maps. The campaigns are inside the game\'s data and don\'t need it. Room: the installer, about as much again while it\'s unpacked, and the converted data. Free now: %1$s. Room: the game\'s size, plus about 1.5 GB for the games\' Windows the first time. Free now: %1$s. Played natively on the phone by Stratagus (War1gus, Wargus): an open-source engine that plays the game from your files, campaigns and skirmishes, the original art and sounds. The intro videos are left out, and Warcraft II\'s music (converting those needs a tool phones don\'t have).

%1$s: files Bring the installed Warcraft III 1.27 folder from a PC (with Warcraft III.exe, War3.mpq, War3x.mpq and Maps in it), or a zip of it. It holds both Reign of Chaos and The Frozen Throne. Bring Warcraft: Orcs & Humans from GOG: its offline installer (the setup .exe and every .bin file that came with it), or the installed folder (with WAR.EXE and the DATA folder in it), or a zip of that folder. The app unpacks and converts it for the phone; it\'s then played natively by Stratagus. Bring Warcraft II Battle.net Edition from GOG: its offline installer (the setup .exe and every .bin file that came with it), or the installed folder (with Warcraft II BNE.exe, Install.mpq and Support\\TOMES in it), or a zip of that folder. The app unpacks and converts it for the phone; it\'s then played natively by Stratagus. Warcraft III is drawn at this size and scaled to the screen: on the Fold\'s 4:3 inside screen, its own shape, it fills the screen exactly. Fewer lines run faster. It applies the next time it starts, for the screen the launcher is on then. Warcraft I and II always fill a 4:3 screen at their own resolutions (480×300 drawn 4:3 as the original was, and 640×480). Swipe one finger Pans the map the way you swipe, for as long as the finger stays away from where it landed. Lift to stop. Tap Right click on the battlefield: move, attack, gather, set a rally point. Where a right click would do nothing, a tap is the left click: in Warcraft I and II on menus and buttons, and on the map when none of your units is selected (the tap selects); in Warcraft III on its bottom panel and top bar. Touch and hold Left click when you lift (after a short buzz): select a unit or building, press a button of the game\'s panel or menus. Hold twice on the same spot Double click: every unit of that kind on the screen. Rest one finger, tap or hold with another Shift-click: queue orders one after another, add units to the selection. Two-finger tap The game\'s menu (save, load, options, quit). Pinch Zoom (the mouse wheel), where the game has it. Three-finger tap The phone\'s keyboard, for chat and cheat codes (sent with Enter). Four-finger tap The app\'s menu: keyboard, CD keys, leave the game. Back Escape: cancel what\'s being aimed, close a window. A mouse or keyboard connected to the phone works as on a PC.
